channel.title: AI Engineer
channel.description:
We turn high signal in-person events for the top AI engineers, founders, leaders, and researchers in the world into the best free learning opportunities for millions around the world here on YouTube. Your subscribes, likes, comments, speaking, attendance, or sponsorships goes a long way toward making our biz model sustainable indefinitely.

We strongly believe this industry deserves a better class of community and that we know how to do this well; we just need your support.
